shape: A long, rambling placement report as plain text (about 3,800 words) with the results buried among digressions and stray figures.
tests: Compression to 200 words or fewer, and choosing the few results that matter over the many distracting numbers (tins of tomatoes, emails, laminating).

keyFacts.fact: Community placement at the (fictional) Eastbrook Community Larder.
Average waiting time fell from 34 to 12 minutes after a tablet sign-in.
Share of donated food thrown away fell from 18% to 7% with colour-coded crates.
Shifts filled a week ahead rose from 64% to 89%.
2,316 visits recorded between February and June.

forbidden.why: Stray figures that don't belong in a 30-second read.
